name: parallels
description: Automate Parallels Desktop for Mac and its Linux or Windows VMs with prlctl and prlsrvctl.

interface.shortDescription: Automate Parallels Desktop and its VMs
interface.longDescription: Inspect and operate Parallels Desktop virtual machines from the macOS host: inventory, power, configuration, guest commands, screenshots, snapshots, clones, archives and host networking, with explicit safety checks before destructive actions.
defaultPrompt: List my Parallels VMs and their state.
Snapshot my Linux VM before changing its CPU and memory.
